rule: FROZEN for the whole run. Any edit is a new rubric version; scores across versions are not comparable. Never re-point an anchor at the loop's own output.
scale: 1-5 absolute; 3 = acceptable shipped-game quality for this layer, 5 = matches the best reference.

game_feel.question: Does this read as a city-builder GAME (Cities: Skylines / Civilization) with clear verbs, goals, feedback and juice, rather than a dashboard, form or slide?
game_feel.1: form, dialog, spreadsheet or plain map; no verbs on the world
game_feel.3: verbs or tools tethered to the world are visible, some feedback
game_feel.5: unmistakably a game: tethered verb wheel/tray, goals/progress, satisfying build feedback

gev_brand.question: Fidelity to the GEV HUD design language: near-black translucent glass, cyan #2EC8E8 accent with soft glow, thin corner brackets, wide-tracked caps headings, monospace numerals, colour only for meaning; the full GEV app shell (wordmark, rails, dock, attribution) present.
gev_brand.3: GEV look mostly present but inconsistent (heavy boxes, missing brackets/glow, shell partly missing)

legibility.question: Can a first-time player read what matters at this zoom in 2 seconds? Info hierarchy by zoom (far = district/yields, mid = plot + verbs, near = details). Text size/contrast, no clutter, no overlaps, no repeated figures.
legibility.1: unreadable or cluttered, overlapping, duplicated numbers

scene_integration.question: Does the proposal/game layer sit IN the photoreal 3D world: shared light, contact with ground, shadows, scale, no floating CG boxes or blurry 2D imagery? Is the world itself convincing at this zoom?
scene_integration.1: blurry 2D imagery or obvious placeholder boxes floating

honesty.question: Are AI/estimate claims honestly labelled (AI concept chip, EST on modelled figures, unknown as '—'), with no fake or contradictory numbers?
honesty.5: every non-observed figure labelled; no fake numbers

wintercats_fidelity.question: Closeness to the owner-chosen 'wintercats' look (A1/A2 refs): warm painterly palette with a colour LUT, soft GI/AO, tilt-shift depth of field and softness, low-poly painterly forms, minimal dark top resource bar + bottom build tray, a placement ghost/build juice, weather as reward.
wintercats_fidelity.1: harsh, desaturated or dashboard-like; no softness; no game HUD minimalism
wintercats_fidelity.3: some of the palette/softness or HUD minimalism

floor: ship needs every beat >= 2 on every layer AND Kevin's verdict; critics never grant approval
pairwise: Each pair is judged in both A/B orders by each judge; a judge's verdict counts only if it holds in both orders, otherwise TIE. Panel verdict = majority of non-tie judge verdicts; no majority = TIE.
